code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Mark interior cells of the dominant rectangular frame color as 2.
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    color=max((v for v in c if v!=bg), key=lambda v:c[v])
    pts=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,x in enumerate(row) if x==color]
    r0,r1=min(i for i,j in pts),max(i for i,j in pts)
    c0,c1=min(j for i,j in pts),max(j for i,j in pts)
    for i,j in pts:
        if r0<i<r1 and c0<j<c1: out[i][j]=2
    return out
'''
